items.q: my wife and I, Liz, vacationed with some friends in Holland.

ctx.x: Oh, about 15 years. He came to visit and stayed with me, but -- had a nice time with him. He's one of the great musicians of our time.
Then we -- my wife and I, Liz, vacationed with some friends in Holland. And we were there when the Moluccans --
Oh, the Moluccans, yeah, they stopped the train.
